responsibility: Implements deserialization of tree nodes from GCC’s LTO/tree-streaming format. It reads indexed strings and identifiers, reconstructs chains and tree headers, unpacks per-structure value bitfields for constants, decls, types, blocks, constructors, vectors, clauses, and expressions, restores pointer relationships and block nesting, and provides the core routines that turn pickled streamed trees back into in-memory GCC tree objects during LTO input.
